evidence.claim: Biosensors da oltre 25 anni progetta, produce e vende dispositivi medici per cardiochirurgia e terapia intensiva, con sede a Singapore e quartier generale europeo a Morges.
evidence.quote: For more than 25 years, Biosensors International has been designing, manufacturing and marketing innovative medical devices used during heart surgery and intensive care treatment. || The Biosensors International Group has operations worldwide and is headquartered in Singapore. The European headquarters are located in Morges (Switzerland).
